catalogueSections.heading: Overview
catalogueSections.markdown:
Full-Stack Developer

COS Great Trading

Led the initial development of an AI-powered CRM, taking ownership of both frontend and backend implementation.

catalogueSections.heading: Achievements
catalogueSections.markdown:
- Established the foundational architecture, reusable components, and core integrations to support future development and scalability.
- Developed the initial infrastructure for department-specific AI knowledge bases using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Pinecone.
- Created technical documentation and development guidelines to support team collaboration, developer onboarding, and long-term maintainability.
- Tech stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Express, Python, MongoDB, Pinecone, and AI SDKs.

exhibits.caption: ONGOING

catalogueSections.heading: Overview
catalogueSections.markdown:
Freelance Full-Stack Developer

Freelance / Client projects

Deliver web applications, custom CMS backends, and CRM platforms for clients, covering development, integration, deployment, and server operations.

catalogueSections.heading: MyRumawip
catalogueSections.markdown:
MyRumawip (property project): developed the bilingual property website, CMS integration, and deployment workflow using Next.js, TypeScript, Strapi, and PostgreSQL.

A bilingual property-discovery website that combines CMS-managed listings, housing-scheme information and educational content with direct WhatsApp enquiries.

Public website: [MyRumawip](https://myrumawip.com/).

- Next.js / TypeScript
- Strapi / PostgreSQL
- Docker / Ansible

catalogueSections.heading: DWMLight / ANVA CMS
catalogueSections.markdown:
DWMLight / ANVA CMS: developed the custom CMS/backend and handled deployment and server operations, using TypeScript, Express, and MongoDB to support structured multilingual content.

A multilingual product and company website backed by a custom content-management API, including localized content, product media and downloadable catalogues.

Public website: [DWMLight](https://dwmlight.com/en).

- TypeScript / Express
- MongoDB / AJV
- PM2 / OpenTelemetry

catalogueSections.heading: Amplifii (Ampress)
catalogueSections.markdown:
Amplifii (Ampress) — current, unreleased: an influencer-marketing platform that helps teams manage creator partnerships and campaigns. Contributing to product development and collaborating with another developer to support the overall user experience.

An influencer-marketing platform that helps teams manage creator partnerships and campaigns.

**Status: Unreleased.** [Preview login](https://amplyfii.io/login?redirect=%2F) is provided as an unreleased preview, not a launched public product.

- Influencer marketing
- Product development
- Team collaboration

catalogueSections.heading: Achievements
catalogueSections.markdown:
- MyRumawip achievement: helped establish the website as a well-known destination for finding affordable housing, achieving top-five Google search rankings for relevant affordable-housing searches.
- DWMLight achievement: helped a China-based client connect with the global market through their multilingual website.

catalogueSections.markdown: I deliver production systems end to end: an AI-powered CRM with RAG knowledge bases, a multilingual CMS backend, and a bilingual property website that reached top-five Google rankings for relevant searches. catalogueSections.markdown: Full-stack development is my main focus, working across frontend, backend, databases, and deployment. I learn the technologies each project requires rather than limiting myself to a single stack.
